invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries answers {libraries: [...]} ordered by displayOrder, each with id, name, folders, displayOrder, icon, mediaType, provider, settings, lastScan, lastScanVersion, createdAt and lastUpdate equal to the stored rows.
?include=stats adds a stats object (totalItems, numAudioFiles, totalDuration, totalSize) to each book and podcast library; without it no stats key is present.
A user whose librariesAccessible is non-empty sees only those libraries, in displayOrder; an all-access user sees all.
